تصطنعوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَنِعُوا (taṣṭaniʕū) /tasˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# تُصْطَنَعُوا (tuṣṭanaʕū) /tusˤ.tˤa.na.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
